title: Extreme crash sends stoplights crashing to ground (2021)
description:
Photo here of troopers investigating the next day: https://twitter.com/SafetyAlertsMN/status/1442935673678299137

"Acura was traveling Southbound Highway 65 approaching Medtronic Parkway at a high rate of speed crossing into the Northbound lanes and hitting the semaphore in the northeast corner of the intersection."


Additional information about this crash will be posted here:
https://app.dps.mn.gov/MSPMedia2/IncidentDisplay/24511
